pincommand.pin.usage: Usage: !pin <message> - pins until removed, replaced, or the stream ends.
pincommand.toolong: The pinned message must be 500 characters or fewer.
pincommand.busy: A pin command is already running. Please try again shortly.
pincommand.pin.success: Message pinned until removed, replaced, or the stream ends.
pincommand.empty: There is no pinned chat message.
pincommand.changed: That message is no longer pinned. The pin may have been removed or replaced.
pincommand.authorization: Twitch denied the request. Reauthorize the bot with user:write:chat and moderator:manage:chat_messages, and make sure it is a moderator. If using broadcaster credentials for moderation, reauthorize the broadcaster too.
pincommand.ratelimit: Twitch is rate limiting pin requests. Please try again shortly.
pincommand.failed: The pin command failed. Please check the bot logs and try again.
pincommand.pin.failed: The message was posted, but could not be pinned. Check the bot logs and moderation permissions before trying again.
pincommand.dropped: Twitch did not send the message, so nothing was pinned. Check chat restrictions or AutoMod.
